No platform data faked; the committed darwin/arm64 lock passes on its own content.

parseReleaseVersion now admits both release shapes: legacy <app-version>-<build> (3.14.1-27, unchanged) and calver 26.9.23 (parsed as { appVersion, build: 0 }). nextBuildVersion bumps the calendar patch component for calver (26.9.23 -> 26.9.24; fixes scripts/smoke-tui.ts, which unblocked the environment-isolation version error). syncedReleaseVersion keeps legacy behavior byte-identical (bare current -> build 1; -<build> current -> same build). compareReleaseVersions orders both shapes (calver 26.9.x > legacy 3.14.x). Calver coverage added to the parser test; all legacy expectations preserved verbatim.
